risk_description: AI use cases may not meet internal governance requirements.
mitigation: Complete governance review before pilot approval; maintain approval checklist.

risk_description: Pilot data may be incomplete or unsuitable for the selected AI use cases.
mitigation: Perform data readiness assessment before pilot launch.

risk_description: Sensitive data could be exposed through an unapproved AI tool or workflow.
mitigation: Restrict pilots to approved tools and complete security review.

risk_description: Employees may not complete required AI training before using pilot tools.
mitigation: Track training completion and block pilot access for incomplete training.

risk_description: Pilot teams may have low adoption because users do not understand the approved use cases.
mitigation: Provide role-specific training, examples, and office hours.

risk_description: Pilot implementation may slip if dependencies are not completed before launch.
mitigation: Use dependency checklist and weekly readiness review.

risk_description: Pilot outcomes may not be measured consistently across teams.
mitigation: Define success measures before pilot launch and use a common evaluation template.

risk_description: An approved AI service may change functionality or availability during the pilot.
mitigation: Document fallback procedures and monitor service availability.
